title: Department of Transportation: Phase 56O Remediation Follow-Through
summary: GAO reports that DOT implemented three of twenty-one prior priority recommendations, added six, removed priority status from two, and now has twenty-two priority recommendations. Phase 56O decision: Publish the exact portfolio movement while preserving workforce, grants, drones, automated-vehicle, and AI-inventory scopes.
key_findings: Exact record: GAO-26-109050 DOT priority recommendation portfolio.
Status period: June 2025 baseline through June 2026.
Continuation rule: Reopen when GAO publishes the next DOT priority letter, changes a named recommendation status, or DOT OIG publishes the FY 2026 review result.
why_it_matters: The record exposes implementation throughput and remaining remediation workload without converting a portfolio into a performance rate.
ftfn_relevance: Keeps implemented, added, de-prioritized, current, modeled, and realized states distinct.
Attaches source, period, scope, limitation, remaining gap, and continuation rule.
evidence_limits: The portfolio spans workforce, grants, drones, and automated vehicles. Its counts do not measure transportation safety, service quality, technology readiness, or the open DOT AI-inventory action.
Action-level closure evidence for the current twenty-two, the open AI-inventory action, and the FY 2026 information-security review result.
No ranking, composite, readiness score, performance rate, or causal claim is supported.
